name: How long does a typical whole home accessibility upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole home accessibility upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole home accessibility upgrade varies significantly depending on the scope and complexity of the modifications. Minor adjustments, such as installing grab bars or a single ramp, might take a few days. More extensive projects, like bathroom or kitchen renovations, widening multiple doorways, or adding a stairlift, can extend from several weeks to a few months. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific needs and the home's current structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: The project timeline depends on the scope of work, from a few days for minor adjustments to several weeks or months for extensive renovations. A detailed timeline is provided after assessment.
